name: Yakhroma-Noginsk Gas Pipeline (Moscow Oblast)
researcher_notes: Matched to existing P2380 (Ring of the Moscow Region, KGMO-1, 365 km, 800 mm, operating). Yakhroma-Noginsk (82 km, built 1985; Gazprom Transgaz Moskva Moskovskoe LPUMG page, Wayback copy) is described there as ensuring reliability and safe operation of KGMO. neftegazpro.ru (2023-11) reports the 2024 start of reconstruction of the ring gas pipeline KGMO-1 'on the section KS Noginsk - KS Yakhroma' (design throughput 28.82 bcm/y, customer Gazprom Transgaz Moskva), i.e. the line is a named sector of KGMO-1, not a separate pipeline. Web-search snippets (unverified fetch) gave 81.9 km / DN1020 for the section and a 12.4 km DN1220 bypass in the KGMO-I reconstruction; not cited. Action for Update: consider whether P2380's 365 km / 800 mm reflects this sector; add 'Yakhroma-Noginsk' to P2380 OtherEnglishNames or leave as a segment note. No new row.
